##### Graphs

A [*graph*](#def-graph) is a set of elements along with a rule describing whether they are connected or not.  Whereas structural equations describe causal structure *within* observational units, graphs provide a language for describing causal structure *across* units.  A graph represents units as *nodes** and possible pathways of influence between units as *edges*.  They help us represent who is *eligible* to affect whom.  Potential outcomes can then be thought of as depending both on a unit’s own treatment values and on those of the units it is directly connected to.
